title: Nonnegativity of the extended-exponent uniform norm
statement: For a finite nonempty set $\Omega$, an extended nonnegative real exponent $q$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the extended-exponent uniform norm of $f$ is nonnegative.
